items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: A brother named Harrison Bowen... Everybody in the band could read it.

ctx.x: You know when I started trying to take a lesson? 1921 I was playing Chris Kelly. I was learning good. I was reading the music. I was reading. And everybody in the band could read it. See the trammel player from over the river, he used to buy the music and he arranged it. A brother named Harrison Bowen, he's a wife of Southern Pacific. And that guy was a good musician. Everybody in the band read it. We had Willie Foster. Willie Foster's brother, he was playing, you know, he'd read. And they got there and they…
Well, which was the Black Eagle? I'm trying to get that straight. Is that E. Van Thomas' Black Eagle or was that your ...?
